scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist
scripts.cf:deploy:production: npm run check:release && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 pages deploy --branch dev
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run check:release && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 pages deploy --branch staging
scripts.cf:deploy:worker:production: npm run check:release && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --env=
scripts.cf:deploy:worker:staging: npm run check:release && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --env staging
scripts.cf:deploy:temporary: npm run check:release && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 deploy --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --temporary --env=
scripts.cf:full:check: npm run check:release && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.cf:full:deploy: npm run cf:full:check && npm --prefix backend run deploy
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 pages dev
scripts.cf:dev:worker: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.0 dev --config wrangler.worker.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run smoke
